title: Picked My Gear For My Own Wedding (31215036318)
author: John Brighenti from Rockville, MD, United States
description: I'm getting married this weekend at Toughannock Falls in upstate New York. While it's going to be a small ceremony, and several people in my family are competent photographers who are going to shoot the wedding, I can't help but insist on doing a little wedding photography of my own. I also am hoping to do some astrophotgraphy since the skies around Ithaca are fairly dark. Sony a7II Sony a7 Sony 2

title: Brooktondale Road Under Trestle 2
author: Unknown author
description: “To get a perspective on the size of this trestle, which was 800 feet long and 85 feet high at its highest point, note the automobile parked beneath it, headed east toward Ithaca on Route 330, now called Brooktondale Road,” Around Caroline.
